name: Wildhorse Creek-Missouri River
places: Missouri Youth Services Center - Babler Lodge
August A. Busch Memorial Conservation Area
Dr. Edmund A. Babler Memorial State Park
about: Wildhorse Creek-Missouri River drains about 33 square miles, 48% of it in St. Charles County. The land ranges from about 850 feet above sea level at its highest point to about 450 feet at its lowest. Its main streams are Wildhorse Creek, Crow Creek, Pillman Creek and Femme Osage Creek. Downstream, its water passes through the Greens Chute-Missouri River, Duckett Creek-Missouri River and Cowmire Creek-Missouri River watersheds on its way down the Missouri River, which joins the Mississippi River at the east end of St. Charles County.
